description: This is a Java test class for benchmarking the JavaScriptMessageMapperRhino component in the Eclipse Ditto project. It contains multiple JUnit test methods that evaluate message mapping scenarios related to JSON payloads, binary data, and their transformations within the Ditto framework.

classes.name: JavaScriptMessageMapperRhinoBenchmarkTest
classes.description: JUnit test class providing benchmark scenarios for the JavaScriptMessageMapperRhino component in the Eclipse Ditto project.

methods.name: simpleMapTextPayload
methods.description: Test method that maps a simple text payload and verifies the payload's content and default properties.

methods.name: test1DecodeBinaryPayloadToDitto
methods.description: Test method that decodes a binary payload into Ditto format and verifies the content.

methods.name: test2ParseJsonPayloadToDitto
methods.description: Test method that parses a JSON payload and checks for specific attribute values.

methods.name: test3FormatJsonPayloadToDitto
methods.description: Test method that formats a JSON payload for Ditto and verifies the conversion.

methods.name: test4ConstructJsonPayloadToDitto
methods.description: Test method that constructs a JSON payload and verifies specific fields.

methods.name: test5DecodeBinaryToDitto
methods.description: Test method decoding binary data into Ditto format and verifying nested JSON content.

methods.name: runScenario
methods.description: Helper method that executes a message mapping scenario and returns the list of adaptable objects.

methods.name: assertDefaults
methods.description: Utility method asserting default topic path properties of the adaptable object.
